parse_notes: Row-extraction method: for each PDF page, the province heading is matched via a 'skeleton' comparison (สระอำ normalized to สระอา, then all Thai combining marks/tone marks ั ิ ี ึ ื ุ ู ่ ้ ๊ ๋ ์ and whitespace stripped from both the candidate 'จังหวัด<name>' string and the page text) - this survives the font's combining-mark-reordering corruption (e.g. 'จังหวัดสุราษฎร์ธานี' extracts as 'จงั หวดั สรุ าษฎร์ธาน ี'; both skeletonize to the same string 'จงหวดสราษฎรธาน'). Amphoe rows are located by a ลำดับ (row-index) marker cell rather than a fixed column position, because several pages carry an extra map-legend column that shifts every column right by one. A second, line-level regex pass (r'^\d{1,3}\s+name\s+area\s+pct%?$') recovers rows on 2-column province layouts (large provinces like เชียงใหม่/นครศรีธรรมราช split their amphoe list into two side-by-side columns; pdfplumber's reading order interleaves them and frequently merges an entire row into one text cell) - this pass alone lifted rubber from 15/77 to 42/77 provinces and rice นาปี from 62/77 to 74/77. amphoe_th is left RAW/uncorrected throughout (a fuzzy-match pass against th_amphoe.geojson is still needed before any amphoe-join); a handful of names lose a leading consonant entirely under the worst corruption (e.g. rubber's เชียงใหม่ page renders 'ฝาง' as 'าง') - kept as extracted, not guessed at.

cassava's missing 27 provinces are STRUCTURAL, not a parse failure: cassava_2567.pdf's own table of contents has NO ภาคใต้ (South) section at all (confirmed by reading pages 1-4) - the report simply does not survey cassava in the South, so every missing cassava province is a southern one. rubber/rice_dry/rice_wet's ToCs DO claim all-region coverage, so their remaining gaps (35, 10, and 3 provinces respectively) are read as genuine unresolved parse gaps, not structural absence, though a page-by-page audit against each ToC's printed page numbers was not completed this session to fully confirm every one.

coconut_aromatic rows come from zone10's OWN 2 single-province surveys (นครปฐม, สมุทรสาคร) - NOT part of the nationwide nother-crop series; coconut is not otherwise covered nationally in this dataset.
oil_palm: file is corrupted at the source (see oil_palm_recovery above) - zero rows.

planted_rai = the single satellite-derived standing/planted area figure for the shown crop year; harvested_rai/production_tons/yield_kg_per_rai are not present in this report type and are null throughout (same schema gap as documented in doae-amphoe-zones891012.md).
